episodes.summary: Reopen the Hazel repair panel because a replacement shuttle jams differently. The Hazel repair panel must add the shuttle jam steps. The accepted Hazel loom manual stays closed while the repair panel is open. For Hazel, you can issue the manual only after Avi accepts the repair panel. For Hazel, permission to issue the manual also requires that the bench record includes a jam test. Both conditions for permission to issue the manual in Hazel are necessary because a normal weave run does not exercise the repair. For the next step on Hazel loom manual, send jam cases to the bench team. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
